session.notes: SharedPreferences 'session': every global DroidDeck setting (display, scaling, FEX preset, Wine sync, CPU cores, memory caps, drivers, components, controller, audio), plus per-game texture filtering as a JSON string (gameTextureFiltering). The app holds it in memory and rewrites the whole file on any change, so DroidDeck must be force-stopped before editing. Read when a session starts; a few (upscaler, sharpness, texture filtering) are also pushed live by in-session menus. Owned by the app uid (u0_a<N>) with SELinux label u:object_r:app_data_file:s0:c<N>,c256,c512,c768.

frame_gen.notes: SharedPreferences 'frame_gen': global frame generation (engine/multiplier/target). Absent until frame generation is first set (means Off). The app creates it the first time Frame generation is picked in the UI; pick it once before editing. Global only, no per-game frame generation in 0.7.1.

game_env.notes: SOURCE OF TRUTH for per-game and shared environment variables (GameEnvironmentStore, AtomicFile). Shape: {"version":1,"shared":{VAR:value},"games":{"<appid>":{VAR:value|null}}}. Every value MUST be a JSON string ("1", not 1) or null; one non-string value makes the app and the guest reject the whole file and games launch with no DroidDeck environment at all. Absent until the first override: create it as exactly {"version":1,"shared":{},"games":{}} before adding keys. 'shared' here holds only user overrides; the app adds its built-in defaults and the global FEX preset when it publishes. The app re-reads it from disk on every use (no cache) and copies it to guest_env at every session start and on display changes.

guest_env.notes: GENERATED, do not edit. The resolved copy the guest launcher /usr/local/bin/droiddeck-game-env reads at every game launch (Steam's 'waitforexitandrun' step): shared = defaults + global FEX preset + game_env.shared, games = game_env.games, plus dxvkConfig/dxvkConfigGames (texture filtering) and gameDebugLogs. Overwritten from game_env + session at session start and display changes. Useful read-only: shows exactly what the next launch uses. With default settings, shared is MESA_SHADER_CACHE_DISABLE=false, DROIDDECK_ANTICHEAT_OFFLINE=1, DOTNET_GCRegionRange=800000000, DOTNET_EnableWriteXorExecute=0 and the Performance + TSO FEX variables.

game_proton.notes: Per-game Proton requests: {"version":1,"games":{"<appid>":{"valve":bool,"dir":"<tool folder>"}|null}}. The guest helper droiddeck-steam-compat watches this file while a Steam session runs and applies it to Steam's own CompatToolMapping through the client's DevTools (so it shows as the game's compatibility tool in Steam). Absent until the first pick: create as {"version":1,"games":{}}. Valid tools are listed in compat_state 'tools'.

compat_state.notes: Guest-written state of the Proton mapper. Read-only. 'tools' lists runnable compat tools as {name, display, dir, valve}; 'default' is the Proton used for every game without its own pick; 'auto' maps app ids to the tool DroidDeck assigned. Checked against 0.7.1: default DroidDeck-Proton-11-11.9 (dir 'DroidDeck-Proton 11-11.9', valve false); Valve tools such as 'Proton Experimental (ARM64)' have valve true.

components.notes: Component packages (DXVK, VKD3D-Proton, FEX) per Proton build ('active') and per game ('profiles': {"<appid>":{"dxvk"|"vkd3d"|"fex":"<package file>.wcp"}}). The app turns it into the guest's droiddeck-components/desired.tsv and unpacks packages at session start (ComponentsManager.republish), so edits apply from the next session. A package must exist in files/components/packages/. The 'profiles' key is absent until a game has its own package. Also written while the app runs (auto-updates, UI), so stop the app before editing.

wincomponents.notes: Windows components (VC++ runtimes, d3dx9 ...) installed per game: {version:1, games:{<appid>:[ids]}, auto:{...}, user:{...}}. Copied to the guest at session start. Usually managed automatically from Steam's redist info; edit only through the Windows components dialog.

per_game.game_id: The Steam app id (decimal, 1..4294967295). Sources: the number inside each Roms/Steam/<Name>.steam file (/storage/emulated/0/Roms/Steam), appmanifest_<appid>.acf in the guest Steam library, files/steam-appinfo.json (id -> name), or the store URL. Non-Steam games added to DroidDeck use their 32-bit shortcut id.
per_game.notes: Per-game environment lives under games/{game}/<VAR> in game_env; a game's entry overrides shared/<VAR>, and a null value unsets the variable for that game. The game entry must exist before a key under it can be written ({"games":{"<appid>":{}}}). Other per-game settings sit in other files and are keyed by the same app id: Proton in game_proton games/{game}, component packages in components profiles/{game}, texture filtering in session gameTextureFiltering#{game}/..., Windows components in wincomponents games/{game}. The UI's 'Default' button for a game clears all five.

no_steam.label: Settings > Start without Steam

values.\"1\": On (launch through droiddeck-proton-run without the Steam client)

no_steam.notes: Unset = Off (launch through Steam). The app also accepts on/true/yes. Applies to launches from DroidDeck and the LAUNCH_GAME intent (FrontEndActivity checks it before starting Steam). Steam overlay, cloud saves and achievements are off in this mode. Env var DROIDDECK_NO_STEAM. Value must be a JSON string: pass numbers quoted ('"60"'), or the whole file is rejected. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

fex_tso.label: FEX preset (TSO, main)
fex_tso.notes: x86 memory-order emulation. Part of the per-game FEX preset: the UI writes all six FEX_* keys together; if they match no preset the UI shows 'Custom FEX variables'. Presets (TSO,VECTORTSO,MEMCPYTSO,HALFBARRIERTSO,X87REDUCED,MULTIBLOCK): STABILITY 1,1,1,1,0,0; COMPATIBILITY 1,1,1,1,0,1; INTERMEDIATE 1,0,0,1,1,1; PERFORMANCE 0,0,0,0,1,1; PERFORMANCE_TSO (app default) 1,0,0,0,1,1; EXTREME = PERFORMANCE + FEX_SMCCHECKS=none, FEX_DISABLEL2CACHE=1, FEX_DYNAMICL1CACHE=1; EXTREME_TSO same with TSO=1; EXTREME_GN = PERFORMANCE + FEX_SMALLTSCSCALE=1, FEX_VOLATILEMETADATA=1; DENUVO = PERFORMANCE + FEX_SMCCHECKS=full, FEX_HIDEHYPERVISORBIT=1. Missing game keys inherit the global preset. Env var FEX_TSOENABLED. Value must be a JSON string: pass numbers quoted ('"60"'), or the whole file is rejected. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

fex_vector_tso.label: FEX preset (vector TSO)
fex_vector_tso.notes: See fex_tso. Env var FEX_VECTORTSOENABLED. Value must be a JSON string: pass numbers quoted ('"60"'), or the whole file is rejected. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

fex_memcpy_tso.label: FEX preset (memcpy TSO)
fex_memcpy_tso.notes: See fex_tso. Env var FEX_MEMCPYSETTSOENABLED. Value must be a JSON string: pass numbers quoted ('"60"'), or the whole file is rejected. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

fex_half_barrier_tso.label: FEX preset (half-barrier TSO)
fex_half_barrier_tso.notes: See fex_tso. Env var FEX_HALFBARRIERTSOENABLED. Value must be a JSON string: pass numbers quoted ('"60"'), or the whole file is rejected. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

fex_x87_reduced_precision.label: FEX preset (x87 reduced precision)
fex_x87_reduced_precision.notes: See fex_tso. droiddeck-game-env forces 0 with full TSO for .NET games it detects. Env var FEX_X87REDUCEDPRECISION. Value must be a JSON string: pass numbers quoted ('"60"'), or the whole file is rejected. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

fex_multiblock.label: FEX preset (multiblock JIT)
fex_multiblock.notes: See fex_tso. Env var FEX_MULTIBLOCK. Value must be a JSON string: pass numbers quoted ('"60"'), or the whole file is rejected. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

fex_smc_checks.label: FEX self-modifying-code checks
fex_smc_checks.notes: Only the Extreme and Denuvo presets set it. Env var FEX_SMCCHECKS. Value must be a JSON string: pass numbers quoted ('"60"'), or the whole file is rejected. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

game_sync_ntsync.label: Wine sync (per game)
game_sync_ntsync.notes: Per-game Wine sync = four keys written together: ntsync BL_SYNC=1,BL_FSYNC_FIRST=0,BL_SYNC_FALLBACK=1; fsync BL_SYNC=0,BL_FSYNC_FIRST=1,BL_SYNC_FALLBACK=1,PROTON_NO_ESYNC=1; esync BL_SYNC=0,BL_FSYNC_FIRST=0,BL_SYNC_FALLBACK=1; wineserver BL_SYNC=0,BL_FSYNC_FIRST=0,BL_SYNC_FALLBACK=0. Any other mix shows as 'Custom sync variables'. Unset all four to use the global sync. Env var BL_SYNC. Value must be a JSON string: pass numbers quoted ('"60"'), or the whole file is rejected. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

game_sync_fsync_first.label: Wine sync: droiddeck-fsync first
game_sync_fsync_first.notes: See game_sync_ntsync. Env var BL_FSYNC_FIRST. Value must be a JSON string: pass numbers quoted ('"60"'), or the whole file is rejected. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

game_sync_fallback.label: Wine sync: fall back to esync/fsync (0 = wineserver only)
game_sync_fallback.notes: See game_sync_ntsync. Env var BL_SYNC_FALLBACK. Value must be a JSON string: pass numbers quoted ('"60"'), or the whole file is rejected. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

proton_no_esync.label: Turn droiddeck-esync off
proton_no_esync.notes: Set by the fsync choice; also a standalone Game environment option. Env var PROTON_NO_ESYNC. Value must be a JSON string: pass numbers quoted ('"60"'), or the whole file is rejected. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

proton_no_ntsync.label: Keep this game off ntsync
proton_no_ntsync.notes: Env var PROTON_NO_NTSYNC. Value must be a JSON string: pass numbers quoted ('"60"'), or the whole file is rejected. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

proton_no_fsync.label: Keep this game off droiddeck-fsync
proton_no_fsync.notes: Env var PROTON_NO_FSYNC. Value must be a JSON string: pass numbers quoted ('"60"'), or the whole file is rejected. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

game_cores.label: Game environment > DROIDDECK_GAME_CORES (CPU cores for this game)
game_cores.notes: Core list like '3-7' or '3,4,5,6,7', replacing the session's Game cores for this game; also sets WINE_CPU_TOPOLOGY so Windows sees only those cores. AYN Thor (SD 8 Gen 2): cpu0-2 small (capacity 280, 2.02 GHz), cpu3-6 medium (855, 2.80 GHz), cpu7 prime (1024, 3.19 GHz). Invalid lists are ignored with a log line. Env var DROIDDECK_GAME_CORES. Value must be a JSON string: pass numbers quoted ('"60"'), or the whole file is rejected. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

fastest_cores.label: Order cores fastest first for Wine
fastest_cores.notes: Default on (unset): Windows sees cores sorted fastest first, trimmed to Proton's per-game CPU limit. 0 turns that off. Env var DROIDDECK_FASTEST_CORES. Value must be a JSON string: pass numbers quoted ('"60"'), or the whole file is rejected. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

dxvk_hud.label: Game environment > DXVK_HUD
dxvk_hud.notes: D3D9-11 overlay; comma list from: scale=0.5, opacity=0.7, devinfo, fps, frametimes, submissions, drawcalls, pipelines, descriptors, memory, gpuload, version, api, cs, compiler, samplers. Env var DXVK_HUD. Value must be a JSON string: pass numbers quoted ('"60"'), or the whole file is rejected. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

dxvk_config.label: Game environment > DXVK_CONFIG
dxvk_config.notes: Semicolon-separated dxvk.conf lines, e.g. 'dxvk.maxFrameRate = 60; d3d11.samplerAnisotropy = 16'. DroidDeck appends its texture-filtering and VRAM-cap options to it. Per-game FPS cap for D3D9-11: dxvk.maxFrameRate = N. Env var DXVK_CONFIG. Value must be a JSON string: pass numbers quoted ('"60"'), or the whole file is rejected. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

dxvk_frame_rate.label: DXVK frame-rate limit (not in the app's list)
dxvk_frame_rate.notes: Standard DXVK env var for a D3D9-11 FPS cap; not in DroidDeck's option catalog (dxvk_config with dxvk.maxFrameRate is the app's suggestion). The app's own hint prefers Steam's Quick Access frame limiter, which is Steam's setting, not a DroidDeck file. Env var DXVK_FRAME_RATE. Value must be a JSON string: pass numbers quoted ('"60"'), or the whole file is rejected. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

vkd3d_frame_rate.label: Game environment > VKD3D_FRAME_RATE
vkd3d_frame_rate.notes: D3D12 FPS cap; 0 disables. Env var VKD3D_FRAME_RATE. Value must be a JSON string: pass numbers quoted ('"60"'), or the whole file is rejected. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

vkd3d_feature_level.label: Game environment > VKD3D_FEATURE_LEVEL

mesa_shader_cache_max_size.notes: Env var MESA_SHADER_CACHE_MAX_SIZE. Value must be a JSON string: pass numbers quoted ('"60"'), or the whole file is rejected. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

pulse_latency_msec.notes: Audio buffer for PulseAudio; raise if audio crackles. Env var PULSE_LATENCY_MSEC. Value must be a JSON string: pass numbers quoted ('"60"'), or the whole file is rejected. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

game_proton_valve.notes: See game_proton_dir. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

game_texture_anisotropy.notes: Per-game override of texture_anisotropy, stored as JSON inside the session pref string gameTextureFiltering (absent until first set; it must exist as "{}" before '#' paths can be written). Becomes DXVK d3d9/d3d11.samplerAnisotropy for this game. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

game_texture_lod_bias.label: Texture sharpness (game)
game_texture_lod_bias.notes: Per-game override of texture_lod_bias (negative mip bias). See game_texture_anisotropy. Read from DroidDeck 0.7.1 source; not set on the test device, effect not tested by launching a game.

resolution.label: Steam session > Display > Resolution
resolution.notes: Gamescope output size for the whole Steam session (games render at or are scaled to it). Not per game. Applies next session.

upscaler.label: Scaling filter
upscaler.notes: How the session image is enlarged to the panel. Legacy 1 maps to 0 and 5 to 4.

upscale_sharpness.label: Filter sharpness
upscale_sharpness.notes: 0-100 in steps of 5; used by GSR, FSR, NIS and Sharpen only.

fex_preset.label: FEX preset (general)
fex_preset.notes: Global FEX tuning for Proton games, published into guest_env shared at session start. Unset means the default; guest_env then shows the Performance + TSO variables. Per-game: the fex_* keys.

force_ssbs.label: Force SSBS
force_ssbs.notes: Adds DROIDDECK_FORCE_SSBS=1; mainly helps Snapdragon 8 Elite. Applies next game launch after a session restart.

sync_ntsync.label: Performance > droiddeck-ntsync
sync_ntsync.notes: Global Wine sync is three bools: ntsync = fastSync true; fsync = fastSync false + fsyncFirst true; esync = both false + syncFallback true; wineserver = all false.

game_cores_global.label: Performance > Game cores
game_cores_global.notes: Comma list of cores for all games, e.g. "3,4,5,6,7". Empty = every core (Android schedules). Per game: game_cores.

client_cores.label: Performance > Client cores
client_cores.notes: Cores for Steam, its UI helper and gamescope when the override is on.

vram_cap_mb.label: Performance > VRAM cap
vram_cap_mb.notes: MB reported to D3D9-12 games (dxgi.maxDeviceMemory). Advisory.

gpu_clock_pin.label: Performance > Hold the GPU at its top clock
gpu_clock_pin.notes: Adreno only; more heat and battery use.

steam_client_arch.label: Steam session > Client > Steam client
steam_client_arch.notes: Which Steam client build runs. Not a per-game setting.

steam_controller.label: Steam session > Controller
steam_controller.notes: How Steam sees the built-in pad. Applies next session. Per-game button layouts are Steam Input's (Steam UI).

android_driver.label: GPU driver (display/compositor side)
android_driver.notes: Turnip build id used by the Android-side compositor. Example: "DD-Turnip_v0.9.1". Must name a folder in files/graphics_driver.

linux_driver.label: GPU driver (games / Linux side)
linux_driver.notes: Turnip build used by games inside the runtime. Must name a folder in files/linux_vulkan_drivers/<id>, e.g. "DD-Turnip_v0.9.1".

direct_audio.label: Steam session > Audio > DirectAudio for games

performance_overlay.label: Steam session > Client > Performance overlay
performance_overlay.notes: Turn off if games crash or go black in Deck mode. Applies next session.

frame_gen_engine.label: Frame generation

values.\"lsfg\": LSFG (Lossless Scaling, needs the Steam app 993090)

frame_gen_engine.notes: Global; the compositor generates frames. LSFG uses Lossless.dll (files/lsfg) from your own copy of Lossless Scaling (Steam app 993090).
